title: Open-interest growth in commodities (Hong and Yogo 2012, JFE)
data: CFTC disaggregated Open_Interest_All for the 12 commodities (GC SI HG CL NG RB HO ZC ZS ZW LE HE), weekly, effective report + 6 days

families.OA aggregate timing: g = log(sum over markets of OI / OI_max-normalised... ) -> growth of the equal-weighted average of each market's OI / its 52-week mean, over L weeks; long the equal-vol commodity basket (0.10/vol/12 each) when g > 0, else flat; L {4, 13, 52}
families.OX cross-section: rank markets by L-week OI growth (log OI_t / OI_t-L); long top 3 / short bottom 3, inverse-vol, rebalanced weekly at the effective date; L {4, 13, 52}

selection: best on 2010-06..2022-12 per family; enters only if > 0.3
judgement: current 14-sleeve book + entrants; ONE evaluation 2023-26 vs 1.102
